measurement_definitions.activation: Exact G474 MODE=NORMAL or MODE=DELAYED delay_ms=<requested> confirmation; command-send alone is insufficient
measurement_definitions.reproduction: An outcome is reproduced only when actually observed in all three G431-B rows and in all three reviewed G431-A rows for that condition
measurement_definitions.stabilization: Fresh NORMAL confirmation, serial boundary, ONLINE baseline and later ONLINE with ok increase >=3, zero counter delta, no unresolved marker
measurement_definitions.trial_window: Four seconds from confirmed-condition command boundary using the primary harness implementation

scope: Second-controller reproduction: G431-B with the same G474-A; not an independent board pair
timing_definition: Host-observed serial receipt and command-send boundaries; no MCU execution-latency inference
wiring: G431 PC4 TX -> G474 PC5 RX; G431 PC5 RX <- G474 PC4 TX; common GND; 115200 8N1
